title: treej nested output
description: Output of `treej /J` or `treej --json`: a single object for the root folder, with items nested under `children`.

timestamp.description: Last modification time, RFC 3339 in UTC, whole seconds.

name.description: File or folder name. Names that are not valid Unicode are converted lossily.

path.description: Absolute path of the root folder. Present only on the root.

target.description: Where a symlink or junction points, when it can be read. Symlinks only.

error.description: Why this item could not be read. A folder with an error has no children.

children.description: Files first, then folders, each sorted by name ignoring case. Absent when the folder was not read (depth limit or error).
